summary: Ported static/sage-{library,sessions,settings,health}.html onto the OpenDesign shell: mockup :root token block verbatim, topbar+hamburger+backdrop+Navigate sidebar (links index.html/sage-workspace.html/etc.), Escape closes modal-first-then-sidebar, prefers-reduced-motion block, single-file inline style/script, snake_case new ids, no comments — while preserving each page's live API logic verified against app/api sources.
final_report: T61 done — four secondary Sage pages ported onto the OpenDesign shell, static-only, no server restart needed, no commit (batch committer owns it). VERIFICATION: extracted each page's inline <script> to %TEMP%\opencode\t61\ and node --check passed on all four; grep checks clean: 0 bare if(mermaid), all 12 fetch calls start '/api/', 0 real comments (the only /*,// pattern hits are https:// font links and the data-URI svg xmlns URL); each page has exactly one h1 (page title; logo is an anchor); all four :root blocks verified BYTE-IDENTICAL to the sage-library.html mockup via regex extract + equality compare. ENDPOINT DEVIATIONS FOUND (all resolved following the proven old file / live server): (1) EXCERPTS — GET /api/files/{id}/excerpts does NOT list chunks: it REQUIRES ?chunk=<chunk_id> and returns ONE object {chunk_id,file_name,location,text,context_around} (app/api/files.py:60-99); no chunk-listing route exists anywhere in app/api, so 'list chunk texts' is impossible static-only. Implemented faithfully to the real contract: clicking a ready row opens the excerpts modal (chunk-id input + Fetch button, hint that chunk ids appear on Workspace citations), rendering location caption + esc()'d text + before/after context, scrollable, close btn + Escape + backdrop; friendly error line on miss/network failure. Note stale precedent: legacy static/app.js calls it without ?chunk expecting {excerpts|chunks:[]} — dead against the live server. If a full chunk listing is wanted, it needs a tiny server-side route (follow-up task candidate). (2) MASTERY RESET — task text guessed POST /api/mastery/reset; old page and server use DELETE /api/mastery (app/api/preferences.py:70). Followed the old file. (3) FILE STATUSES — server emits pending/ready/partial/failed (services/files.py _mark_failed sets 'failed'); the old page's retry check f.status==='error' was dead code against it. New mapping: ready→foam pill + clickable excerpt row; failed/error→love pill + error line under name + retry button (POST /api/files/{id}/retry); pending/partial→gold pill; retry also honors legacy 'error'. (4) TOKENS — brief quoted --dur 180ms but NO mockup or shipped page carries it; mockups say --dur:1120ms/--dur-slow:500ms, matching the repo's shipped shell; copied verbatim per instruction. Content max-widths follow the mockups per-page (900/900/700/600px) not a uniform 1000px. BEHAVIOR PRESERVED BEYOND BRIEF MINIMUM: Library upload zone click+drag-drop POST /api/files multipart field 'files' (multiple) then refresh, delete with confirm(), sidebar Files section still fed by GET /api/files (Navigate-only sidebars elsewhere; mockup's fake Sessions/Plan sections intentionally dropped); Sessions kept the New Session modal wired to POST /api/sessions {goal,grounding_mode}, cards navigate to sage-workspace.html?session={id}, DELETE /api/sessions/{id} after confirm then refresh, empty state 'No sessions yet / Start one from Home.' linking index.html, phase colors setup=muted probe=gold plan=gold teach=accent check=rose complete=foam, relative updated_at; Settings GET/PATCH /api/preferences {depth,pacing,style,notes} with selects bound to server Literals (brief/standard/deep, slow/normal/fast, analogy-first/examples-first/formal-first) + notes textarea, save feedback now button-label swap ('Saved ✓') instead of alert(), danger reset with confirm(); Health GET /api/health manual refresh only (old file had no polling interval to keep), ok/degraded/error → foam/gold/love icon+badge, model_configured and endpoint_reachable rows with colored dots, dependency_errors list, checked_at mono caption, Connection Failed fallback card preserved, Refresh = small primary button with icon in the page header. All new ids snake_case; modal Escape precedence (modal first, then mobile sidebar); Playwright NOT run per brief.
